config.grain_rationale: One row per ACNC-registered charity; the record describes the registered legal entity and its registered address. ABN is not guaranteed unique in a row (duplicates/blanks occur), so record identity is content-derived.

record_id.rationale: ABN repeats across 6 held-out records and is blank in some rows, so it is not a unique key; hash the record content instead.

fields.rationale: Column explicitly named Charity_Legal_Name from the ACNC register = registered legal name.
Other names a charity is known by (trading/display names); explicitly separate from the legal name column.
ABN column, 100% checksum-valid in discovery and holdout samples.
Charity_Website values are domains or URLs.
ACNC registration date, DD/MM/YYYY shape confirmed for all values.
Street address lines combined; values may be PO boxes/contact addresses rather than premises (Address_Type is uniformly 'Business').
4-digit Australian postcodes; a rare malformed value fails validation.

Country field, ~89% present: 'Australia'/'AUSTRALIA' normalise to ISO code 'AU' (ontology default) so profiles do not show false conflicts with other sources; the few non-Australian values (e.g. Singapore) pass through as uppercase text (address.country is a plain string, not an enum) so no data is silently dropped. Replaces a raw-text passthrough per reviewer feedback.

unmapped.reason: Single constant value 'Business' on all rows (address contact type); no ontology target.
When the organisation was founded, not when the ACNC registration became true; not a substitute for date_registered.
ACNC revenue-size band (Small/Medium/Large); no ontology target.
Reporting period fit, e.g. 30-Jun; not a valid_from/valid_to date.
State operation flag; address.state comes from the registered address, not operation footprint.

config.notes: Charity purpose ('Advancing_*' etc.) and beneficiary-type flag columns (29-69) are Y/N indicators with no ontology target and are left unmapped. entity.status is NOT mapped: the source has no per-row status column and extracts can include revoked/deregistered charities, so asserting 'active' for all rows would be guesswork. entity_type likewise not mapped: suffix text (Incorporated/Ltd/Trust) is not a structured entity-type field. Address values may be postal/contact addresses (Address_Type uniformly 'Business'), which is why address.full confidence is moderate. No per-row observation date; fallback to resource last-modified. One rare 6-digit Postcode value (139658) fails validation by design (source defect). Country normalised to 'AU' for Australian values per reviewer feedback; rare overseas values pass through as uppercase text.
